answer_1.quote: The fundamental competency of large language models resides in their generative performance. To evaluate the generative capability of the sparsified models, we conducted comprehensive perplexity experiments across different sparsity levels...
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generative performance through perplexity on WikiText2 and C4, which are standard benchmarks for language modeling and text generation.

answer_2.quote: We assess the generative capabilities of the sparsified models on the WikiText2 and C4 datasets... We evaluate all models on five zero-shot tasks, including ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, PIQA, and Winogrande. Furthermore, we conduct evaluations on the 5shot MMLU and GSM8K tasks.
